children: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted preliminary conditional approval on September 18 for Catena to establish Catena Trust Bank, N.A., which is in formation. According to ChainCatcher, the bank would operate under OCC supervision if it receives full approval.
The proposed bank is expected to provide fiduciary digital asset custody, investment management, and trust services.

title: OCC Grants Preliminary Conditional Approval to Catena Trust Bank for AI Agent-Focused Financial Services
